summary: {inspector} finds a curb ramp taking up space beside a designated parking spot.
realLife: At Livingston Employment Services, inspectors found that the built-up ramp intruded into the parking access aisle.
gates: A parking layout includes a curb ramp that occupies the access aisle.
inGame: needs: the access aisle, curb ramp footprint and proposed parking layout.

turns.what: The inspector marks the space the ramp still occupies.
turns.pulledBy: A contractor proposes repainting the stall in place.
turns.writesBack: The plan goes back for a layout change.

turns.what: The inspector measures the remaining clear aisle.
turns.pulledBy: A revised layout separates the two uses.
turns.writesBack: The inspection records the new clearance.
